component.name: Hearthlink
component.summary: World of Warcraft data uploaders for Linux

description.p: Hearthlink does on Linux what the Windows uploaders of several World of Warcraft fan sites do, in one app with a tray icon:

ul.li: Wowhead: uploads the game caches and Wowhead Looter data and keeps the Looter addon up to date (like the Wowhead Client)
WowUtils: sends your character data, brings your raid group's wishlists into the game and sends RCLootCouncil loot history (like the WowUtils Bridge)
ForeverDB: installs, updates and runs ForeverDB's official Linux uploader
wowaudit: brings your team's wishlists into the game and sends loot history and companion data (like the wowaudit desktop client)

description.p: It finds your game in Lutris, Wine, Bottles and Steam/Proton folders, and tells you when one of the original Windows apps gets a version this port doesn't know yet.
Hearthlink is a community project, not made by or affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment, Wowhead, WowUtils, wowaudit or ForeverDB.
First release: Wowhead, WowUtils (with heartbeat and RCLootCouncil loot history), wowaudit and ForeverDB.
